from: October book, night 27 (The Pot Made New)
p1: The Lord told Jeremiah, “Go down to the potter’s house.” So Jeremiah went to see a man who made pots and bowls from clay.
The potter sat at his wheel. It spun around and around while his hands shaped the soft, wet clay.
But the pot got spoiled in his hands. So the potter shaped that clay into a new pot.
p2: The Lord said, “Like clay in the potter’s hand, you are in My hand.” His people had made wrong choices. If they came back to Him, the Lord could make them new.
When you make a mistake, you are still safe in Heavenly Father’s hands. He gently helps you start new.
old: Long ago there was a man named Jeremiah. He was a prophet. That means Heavenly Father told him things to say to the people. The people had stopped listening, and their hearts had gone a little crooked, like a pot that leans. Heavenly Father wanted them to come back to Him.

So Heavenly Father said, "Go down to the potter's house, and I will talk to you there." A potter makes pots and bowls out of soft, wet mud called clay. He sits by a round table that spins and spins, and he shapes the clay with his hands.

Jeremiah went and watched. The table spun round and round. The wet clay grew tall under the potter's two steady hands. Then one pot did not come out right. It leaned and flopped and lost its shape, right there in the potter's hands.

The potter did not throw that clay away. He gathered it up, soft and whole, and made it into a good pot again, just the way he wanted it. Heavenly Father said, "You are like the clay, and I am like the potter." He showed Jeremiah this picture so the people would know they could come back and be shaped kind and good again.
